'''Clayton Atkin''' played the [[2022 Endor Grand Prix]]. He was listed as 2000 California State Champion on [[Red 32's Star Wars CCG Site]].<ref name="red32-home">[https://web.archive.org/web/20210513214727/https://cmikehardy.tripod.com/starwarsccg.htm Red 32's Star Wars CCG Site] (Wayback, 13 May 2021)</ref><ref name="pc-rem">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2022-endor-grand-prix/ 2022 Endor Grand Prix], starwarsccg.org</ref>
